title: Smaller Models, Better Rejects: Preference Distillation Scaling

summary.claim: In preference distillation, using responses from smaller frozen models as rejects beats the student's own failures: less compute and a stronger student.
summary.condition: Students from 7B to 72B, code generation and math reasoning; a DPO utility bound derived with a linearized feature model.
summary.gap: (Inferred) Only tasks with clear answers are tested, so it is unknown whether this holds for fuzzy preferences such as safety or honesty.
